meta.problem:
Rick ordered two pizzas and invited a couple of friends over for dinner. The pizzas were each divided into six slices. Together Rick and his friends ate nine slices, or 9/6 of a pizza. Use the number line to show this fraction.
What is the fraction in the problem?

hintsPerCorrectStep: Enter 9 in the box.
Enter 6 in the box.
If you want to convert the fraction to a mixed number, click "Convert", if not, simply click on the number line to place your fraction to complete the problem.

What is the maximum number of 6/6 that can fit into 9/6?

Numerator of the mixed number is the remainder of the division between the numerator and the denominator of the improper fraction!
